📜 Another Milestone in My Machine Learning Journey | Unlox Edge Certification

I'm excited to share that I have successfully completed all modules of the Job Bridge Program and have been awarded the Unlox Edge Certification specialized in Machine Learning.

This certification represents an important milestone in my learning journey and reflects the foundation I have built across different areas of Machine Learning.

During this learning journey, I gained hands-on exposure to:

• Data Analysis & Preprocessing
• Exploratory Data Analysis
• Machine Learning Algorithms
• Regression & Classification
• Unsupervised Learning
• Deep Learning Fundamentals
• Natural Language Processing
• Model Evaluation
• Machine Learning Applications

The knowledge gained through this program has helped me move from learning individual concepts to applying them through practical projects.

I'm grateful to UNLOX® and Sruthi Tarimana for their guidance, support, and for providing me with the opportunity to strengthen my Machine Learning fundamentals.

Looking forward to continuing my learning journey and building more practical AI/ML projects.
